context: Tatsuya updates Ryosuke on country agriculture prices.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 亮介、今年の米の量、減りそうだ。
lines.en: Ryosuke — this year's rice crop is going to come up short.
lines.style: Slow, unhurried opening. Low comfortable register. States fact with quiet acceptance, not complaint. Pause between thoughts, like watching weather move across fields. Gentle, steady warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: そうですか。市場、価格、上がりますね。
lines.en: I see. The market prices will probably go up then.
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment. Thoughtful pause after the first phrase, turning the problem over mentally. Warm but grounded — not optimistic, just realistic. Steady presence.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 天気、悪かったから、仕方ない。
lines.en: The weather was rough this year. Can't be helped.
lines.style: Philosophical exhale. No bitterness, just the tone of someone who has weathered many seasons. Matter-of-fact acceptance layered with quiet patience. Trailing acceptance at the end.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: That'll hit the household budget too.
lines.style: Honest but gentle acknowledgment. Not lamenting — just thinking out loud with someone he trusts. Slight worry in the steadiness, like he's already running the numbers.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 直接、買ってくれる、家族、助かる。
lines.en: But the families buying direct from us — that helps.
lines.style: Slow recognition, almost relief. Lighter than before. Notices the small good thing without overstating it. Warm gratitude threaded through.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 優子と、相談して、続けます。
lines.en: I'll talk it over with Yumiko and we'll figure it out.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Not a promise to fix everything, but a promise to face it together. Tender resolve — soft but certain. The voice of someone who knows what matters.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ありがたい。一緒に、頑張ろう。
lines.en: I appreciate that. Let's keep working at it together.
lines.style: Closing warmth. Genuine gratitude without excess. Slow, steady tempo. Hand-on-shoulder tone even without touching. A benediction more than a goodbye.
